info.description:
Read-only view of what TORNE has really established.

**The canonical prefix is `/api/v1`.** It is the only prefix this document describes.

**The legacy prefix `/api` still answers.** It answers the same questions as `/api/v1`, marks every answer with `Deprecation: true`, and names its successor in a `Link` header. A consumer that follows the header has migrated itself.

**The removal rule.** The legacy prefix will be removed in **one announced step**, once the first application published outside this repository consumes `/api/v1`. It is never removed as a side effect of another change: the step is announced in this document and recorded in the commit that makes it. Until then, the legacy prefix is a supported surface, and its answers carry the headers that say so.
